name: AI Weekly Client Report Generator (Marketing Agencies)

values.content:
=You are a senior marketing analyst. Write a 150-200 word weekly performance summary for {{ $json.company }} ({{ $json.industry }}).

Data: Spend ${{ $json.totalSpend }}, Conversions {{ $json.totalConversions }}, Revenue ${{ $json.totalRevenue }}, ROAS {{ $json.roas }}x (prev: {{ $json.prevRoas }}x).
Channels: {{ JSON.stringify($json.channels) }}

Include: overall trend, best/worst channel, one actionable recommendation. Write in second person. Sign as '— Your Growth Team'. Wrap between <<<REPORT>>> and <<<END>>>.

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.company }} — Weekly Performance Report
